purpose: Findings that verify_public.py raises correctly and that are cleared by a named step in the publication execution sequence rather than by an edit to this repository. Each entry names the step that clears it. A deferral that stops matching anything is a FAIL, so this list cannot rot quietly.
rule: A deferral suppresses nothing at release. scripts/verify_public.py --strict treats every deferral as a failure, and the release workflow runs --strict. This file lets day-to-day CI stay green while the corpus is mid-sequence; it does not let anything ship.

deferrals.clears_at: Execution sequence step 14. The prepared edits to P-001 and P-007 are applied by the Research Program and the public texts are imported.
deferrals.reason: P-001 and P-007 are approved for Wave 1 and their public texts are gated on prepared edits that have not been applied. Importing the unedited sources into a public repository would publish material the Program has already ruled must change.

deferrals.clears_at: Execution sequence steps 12 and 14. The stale identifier notes are removed and the named section reductions are applied, then the public texts are imported.
deferrals.reason: The three technical notes are approved for Wave 1 with named changes. Two of those changes remove material classified above PUBLIC. The unedited sources therefore cannot enter this repository at all.

deferrals.clears_at: Execution sequence step 15. Every Canonical URL front-matter field is rebound to the canonical host in one mechanical act.
deferrals.reason: The imported texts carry the canonical URL as a placeholder annotated with the governance item that gates it. The annotation is correct today and is removed when the host determination takes effect on signature.

deferrals.clears_at: Execution sequence step 8. The R-009 identifier is allocated, the register is bumped, and the upstream baseline is re-verified as one act.
deferrals.reason: R-009 states that its identifier is requested and not allocated, and names the register it is absent from. Naming the internal register on a public page is the defect; stating that the identifier is unallocated is not, and that statement stays.

deferrals.clears_at: Execution sequence step 14. Internal governance citations in version-history rows and reviewer annotations are replaced with reader-facing wording.
deferrals.reason: Version-history rows cite the internal instrument that caused a revision. A reader needs to know that a correction happened and what changed; the instrument reference is internal control structure and is replaced by an erratum reference on the updates page.
